title: Fundamental theorem of calculus along a ray: ∫_0^∞ (d/dt) f(te) dt = −f(0) (parent step 5)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let f : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ with compact support, and let e ∈ ℝ^P with |e| = 1. Then ∫_{(0,∞)} deriv (s ↦ f(s·e))(t) dt = −f(0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → ∀ e : Euclid P, ‖e‖ = 1 → ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (s • e)) t = -f 0
